description: Combined view of metrics, logs, and traces across all namespaces

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace",namespace!~"$nsHide", pod=~"$pod", container=~"$container", container!="", container!="POD", container!~"linkerd-proxy|istio-proxy|otel-collector|fluent-bit|filebeat|vault-agent|oauth2-proxy"}[5m])))
sum by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace",namespace!~"$nsHide", pod=~"$pod", container=~"$container", resource="cpu"})

topk(20, sum by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace",namespace!~"$nsHide", pod=~"$pod", container=~"$container", container!="", container!="POD", container!~"linkerd-proxy|istio-proxy|otel-collector|fluent-bit|filebeat|vault-agent|oauth2-proxy"}))
sum by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace",namespace!~"$nsHide", pod=~"$pod", container=~"$container", resource="memory"})

panels.description: Error rate for inbound requests the service handled (SPAN_KIND_SERVER only). Excludes failures of outbound/internal dependency calls — see "Dependency Error Rate by Service" for those.

sum by (service) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service", http_response_status_code=~"4.."}[5m])) or sum by (service) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service", http_status_code=~"4.."}[5m]))

sum by (service) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service", http_response_status_code=~"2.."}[5m])) or sum by (service) (rate(traces_spanmetrics_calls_total{service=~"$service", http_status_code=~"2.."}[5m]))

panels.description: HTTP response code rate per service. Requires OTel collector spanmetrics processor to include http.response.status_code (or http.status_code) as a dimension. Empty if dimension is not exported.
panels.title: HTTP Response Code Rate by Service (2xx / 4xx / 5xx)

panels.description: Error rate of OUTBOUND/INTERNAL dependency calls a service makes (SPAN_KIND_CLIENT and SPAN_KIND_INTERNAL) — e.g. failed Azure AD token acquisition, Microsoft Graph, downstream HTTP, DB. A high value here does NOT mean the service is returning errors to its callers (see "Server Error Rate by Service"); it means one of its dependencies is failing.
